newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks dip at noon as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks dip at noon as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistan stocks slipped at noon on Thursday in lacklustre trading with investors on the sidelines before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget due in June, dealers said.

"Trading volume has declined as investors wait for the budget," dealer Mohammad Iqbal said. "Activity is low even in speculative scrips and only select energy stocks are in demand." The budget will be announced on June 14.
The index fell 6.25 points, or 0.40 percent, to 1,549.99 by noon. Hub Power fell 0.30 rupees to 37.65 and ICI Pakistan 0.25 to 24.60. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
